projectName: Gold Runner - Lode Runner Style Clone
projectDescription: Single-screen Lode Runner style Mideas clone: collect gold, climb ladders, use ropes, dig bricks and avoid guards.

data.name: Ladder Climb
data.description: Allows climbing passable ladder tiles using up/down input.

data.name: Rope Traverse
data.description: Allows horizontal traversal while hanging from rope tiles.

data.name: Dig Brick
data.description: Breaks a diggable brick to the lower-left or lower-right, then respawns it.

properties.name: respawnFrames
properties.description: Frames before a dug brick returns.

properties.name: diggableTileIds
properties.description: Tiles that can be removed by digging.

data.name: Gold Goal
data.description: Tracks gold collection and opens the exit when the target is reached.

properties.name: targetVariable
properties.description: Global variable incremented by collecting gold.

properties.name: targetCount
properties.description: Gold pieces required to complete the level.

properties.name: exitVariable
properties.description: Boolean global set when enough gold is collected.

data.name: Guard AI
data.description: Simple patrol/chase guard for Lode Runner style pressure.

properties.name: chaseRange
properties.description: Range in pixels for detecting player.

data.name: Gold Runner Player
data.description: Playable runner. Collects all gold, digs bricks, climbs ladders and uses ropes.

data.name: Gold Runner Guard
data.description: Patrol guard that pressures the player across platforms.

customVariables.name: ExitOpen
customVariables.description: Exit ladder available after all gold is collected.

customVariables.name: OnLadder
customVariables.description: Runtime helper set when player overlaps ladder.
